strategies.title: Minimal Pydantic v2 Migration
strategies.rationale: Keep core functionality in-place while updating the pydantic dependency pin and making the smallest possible API change to adapt parse_obj/parse_raw/dict calls.
ordered_steps: Replace `user.dict(by_alias=True, exclude_none=True)` in api.py with `user.model_dump(by_alias=True, exclude_none=True)`.
Add Pydantic V2 compatibility wrappers for validator/root_validator in models.py.

strategies.title: Backwards Compatibility Layer
strategies.rationale: Introduce pydantic.v1 shims so existing tests continue to pass without changing source logic.
ordered_steps: Add a compatibility module that re-exports pydantic.v1 BaseModel, validator, root_validator.
Import compatibility module in models.py and api.py instead of pydantic directly.
Keep test files untouched; compatibility shims bridge v1 API to v2 internals.

strategies.title: Full Refactor to Pydantic v2 Idioms
strategies.rationale: Remove all v1-specific APIs and adopt v2 model_validate/model_dump patterns, drop deprecated validators where equivalent exists natively.
ordered_steps: Replace `from pydantic import ...` with `from pydantic.v1 import ...` in models.py if any v1-only features remain, otherwise use native v2.
Replace all `parse_obj` calls with `model_validate`, `parse_raw` with `model_validate_json`, `dict(...)` with `model_dump(...)`.
Update Config class to v2 syntax (add model_config with appropriate fields).
Remove any v1-only validators that have native v2 equivalents or can be simplified.
